message:
♦️ FLEX ULTIMATE V2.0.0 IS LIVE!

The 2.0.0 release for Premiere Pro is officially here. This update introduces Flex AI Cloud, transcript-driven Auto Retake Deletion, an expanded Asset & Preset Library, and major timeline stability overhauls.

♦️ Flex AI Engine & Cloud Image Generation
* Included Cloud AI: Flex AI is now the default engine using your existing license—no third-party API keys, downloads, or local setups required.
* Cloud Transcription: Multilingual cloud transcribing for Auto Captions and Retakes with word-level accuracy.
* Direct Image Generation: Generate images inside the panel using Flex AI credits, landing non-destructively on a free video track directly at your playhead.

♦️ Transcript-Driven Auto Retakes (Silence Tab)
* Spoken-Word Analysis: Analyzes what was actually said (not just loudness) to catch restarted sentences, repeated lines, and filler apologies in English and Hinglish.
* Interactive Transcript Review: Review every word on screen with proposed cuts struck through. Click single words or full lines to rescue or cut them before committing.
* Single-Edit Undo: Retake and silence removals execute in a single Ripple Delete action, making complete undo possible with one Ctrl+Z.

♦️ Expanded Assets, MOGRTs & Light Leaks
* Presets & Templates Library: Browsable grid featuring 867 Motion Graphics templates across 18 categories, plus 40 bundled Text Animation templates with live hover previews.
* Light Leak Video Pack: Includes 10 flare transitions that auto-scale to fill 4K or vertical 9:16 frame shapes with Screen blend mode and flare-peak markers snapped to your playhead.

♦️ Auto Captions & Silence Engine Upgrades
* Selective Range Transcribing: Choose between Full File, Selected Clip Only, or Sequence In-Out ranges to save time.
* 41 Native-Script Languages: Support for 41 languages displayed in their native writing systems.
* Dynamic RMS Audio Profiling: Silence detection measures per-clip volume levels to handle room tone and mid-pause breaths without leaving frame slivers.

♦️ Critical System & Timeline Fixes
* True Adjustment Layers: Now generates authentic Premiere File > New > Adjustment Layer items that pass down timeline effects.
* Targeted Easing Curves: The Graph Editor now features a property selection strip, preventing scale curves from overwriting position or opacity channels.
* Non-Destructive Operations: Unnesting now preserves keyframes, animations, and effects; Layer Control Stairs maintains linked audio-video sync.
* Cross-Platform Fixes: Resolved Windows URI pathing errors (/C:/...), UI dropdown freezes, and restored full .mogrt backwards compatibility across Premiere 2022–2026.
